items.title: MPVRP with changeover costs
items.description: I proposed models using mixed-integer linear programming and sequence variables in constraint programming approaches for the multi-product vehicle routing problem with changeover costs (MPVRP-CC); conducted computational experiments, and analyzed results.

items.title: Automated real estate mapping
